zh: 金管局與證監會合辦研討會
探討Project Ensemble代幣化存款
代幣化存款已實現全天候24/7運作
work.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Securities and Futures Commission co-hosted a seminar on Project Ensemble and tokenised investment products on 11 November. Around 200 industry practitioners attended to discuss scale following the implementation of 24/7 tokenised deposits.
work.title: Project Ensemble Seeks Scale After Tokenised Deposits Go 24/7

zh: 港交所將於12月14日推數碼支付方案
便利結算參與者於收市後時段預繳按金
基於批發層面CBDC採用24/7運作模式
work.en: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing will launch a new digital payment solution on 14 December to help clearing participants pay post-expiry pre-margin requirements. Building on a joint initiative with the HKMA, the solution utilises wholesale CBDC operating on a 24/7 basis, allowing application submissions between 5:00 PM and 1:30 AM.
work.title: 港交所下月推出新數碼支付方案 支付收市後交易時段預繳按金

zh: 金管局經貼現窗向銀行放水76.6億元
創下近7年以來最高單日放水金額
反映本地銀行體系流動性需求上升
work.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority injected HK$76.6 billion into the banking system through its discount window. This marks the highest liquidity injection level through the facility in nearly seven years.
work.title: 金管局經貼現窗向銀行放水76.6億 近7年最多

zh: 外匯基金10月境外資產增加570億港元
境外資產總額升至36330億元
同期貨幣基礎錄得20947億港元
work.en: Hong Kong Monetary Authority data shows foreign assets of the Exchange Fund increased by HK$57.0 billion in October to HK$3,633.0 billion. The monetary base stood at HK$2,094.7 billion at the end of the month.
work.title: 外匯基金上月境外資產增加570億港元

zh: 微軟系統全球大死機影響多國
金管局確認港零售銀行關鍵系統正常
當局提醒市民提防相關網絡詐騙
work.en: Following a major global Microsoft outage, the HKMA confirmed that key systems of Hong Kong retail banks, including deposit and transfer services, remained in normal operation. The regulator urged the public to stay vigilant against potential scams.
work.title: 【微軟全球大死機】金管局:港銀存款、轉帳等維持正常運作

zh: 港元定期存款長息創下3.6厘新高
部分短息定存優惠最高達20厘
大象銀行推出兩年期千元起存3.5厘
work.en: Hong Kong dollar time deposit rates have seen competition intensify, with long-term rates reaching a high of 3.6% and select short-term promotion rates reaching up to 20%. Major banks are offering two-year deposits at 3.5% with a low entry threshold of HK$1,000.
work.title: 定期存款

zh: 月之暗面傳擬明年初在港上市
該AI企業計劃集資最多50億美元
星宸科技及國星宇航亦推進港上市
work.en: AI firm Moonshot AI reportedly aims to list in Hong Kong early next year to raise up to US$5 billion. Meanwhile, chipmaker SigmaStar plans to raise HK$2.3 billion, and ADA Space was oversubscribed 2.4 times in its retail offering.
work.title: 「太空AI第一股」在港上市 將落戶設國際總部 國星宇航招股獲2.4倍超額認購 孫東冀更多硬科技企業善用港優勢

juicy_sg.headline: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Facing 3rd Affair Allegations as Divorce Rumors Swirl
juicy_sg.body: Former Nvidia chief Jensen Huang is facing reports of a third alleged affair involving a second company employee. The allegations have raised speculation that a divorce could result in a division of assets worth around US$70 billion (S$90 billion) for his wife Lori.
juicy_sg.title: Jensen Huang’s 3rd affair allegations with 2nd Nvidia employee fuel divorce speculation; wife could get S$90B upon separation

juicy_sg.headline: Man Facing 41 Charges in Singapore Nvidia Chips Investigation
juicy_sg.body: A man in Singapore has been handed 41 criminal charges in connection with a major inquiry into Nvidia AI chips. The case has drawn international attention to regulatory oversight within the local technology trade sector.
juicy_sg.title: Man handed 41 charges in relation to Nvidia chips case

juicy_sg.headline: Woman Sentenced to 13 Years' Jail for Conspiring in Fatal Abuse of Child
juicy_sg.body: A 36-year-old Singaporean woman was sentenced to 13 years' imprisonment for participating in the severe abuse of four-year-old Megan Khung and assisting in disposing of her body. The presiding judge advised the defendant to use her prison term for reflection.
juicy_sg.title: ‘Use the time in prison to reflect on your actions’ — SG judge tells Singaporean woman, 36, who gets 13 years’ jail for conspiring in Megan Khung child abuse case

juicy_sg.headline: Domestic Helper Arrested After 3-Hour Police Standoff in Clementi Flat
juicy_sg.body: A 27-year-old domestic helper suspected of theft locked herself inside a Clementi apartment with a knife, triggering a three-hour police standoff. Officers arrested the woman, and one person was taken to the hospital by SCDF.
juicy_sg.title: Maid who was suspected of theft locks herself in Clementi flat with knife; SCDF conveyed one person to hospital

juicy_sg.headline: Changi Airport Food Court Brawl Ends in 11-Week Jail Sentence
juicy_sg.body: A violent fight broke out between two women and Thai workers at a Changi Airport food court. Following court proceedings, one participant was handed an 11-week prison sentence.
juicy_sg.title: 2 women, Thai workers, fight at Changi Airport food court, 1 jailed for 11 weeks

juicy_sg.headline: Fire at 80-Year-Old Chinatown TCM Shop Forces 40 Evacuations
juicy_sg.body: A fire broke out at an 80-year-old traditional Chinese medicine and liquor establishment in Chinatown. Two individuals were taken to the hospital while SCDF and emergency teams evacuated around 40 people.
juicy_sg.title: Fire at 80-year-old Chinatown TCM and liquor shop sends 2 to hospital, forces 40 to evacuate

juicy_sg.headline: Police Arrest 8 Teenagers Over Late-Night Door-Knocking Pranks in Hougang
juicy_sg.body: Eight teenagers aged between 12 and 15 were arrested by police for repeatedly knocking on doors late at night in a Hougang residential block. The suspects allegedly filmed the pranks and published the videos online.
juicy_sg.title: 8 teenagers suspected of knocking on Hougang residents’ doors at night and posting videos online
